# Market Router — Complete API Reference for AI Agents

> OpenAI-compatible AI API routing platform. One key, 40+ providers, smart cost optimization.

---

## What is Market Router?

Market Router is an AI API relay service that sits between your application and AI model providers. You send requests using the standard OpenAI API format, and Market Router:

1. Authenticates your API key
2. Routes to the optimal provider (by cost, latency, or availability)
3. Returns the response in standard OpenAI format
4. Deducts credits from your balance

**Target users**: Developers, AI Agent builders, Vibe Coders, teams using Cursor/Cline/Claude Code/Continue/n8n/LangChain/AutoGen, and anyone wanting to reduce AI API costs or access CN-region models without a VPN.

---

## Base URL

```
https://marketrouter.ai/v1
```

All endpoints are OpenAI API-compatible. Simply replace `https://api.openai.com` with `https://marketrouter.ai` in any existing integration.

---

## Authentication

```http
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

Get your API key: Log in → Console → API page → Create API Key.

API keys start with `sk-mr-`.

---

## Endpoints

### Chat Completions
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
```

Fully compatible with OpenAI's chat completions API. Supports:
- `model` — any model from the supported list
- `messages` — system / user / assistant / tool roles
- `stream` — true/false for streaming (SSE)
- `temperature`, `max_tokens`, `top_p`, `frequency_penalty`, `presence_penalty`
- `tools` / `tool_choice` — function calling
- `response_format` — JSON mode (`{"type":"json_object"}`)
- `reasoning_effort` — for reasoning models (o1, o3, deepseek-r1)

**Example:**
```bash
curl https://marketrouter.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-mr-YOUR_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-4o",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello, what can you do?"}],
    "stream": false
  }'
```

### Streaming
```bash
curl https://marketrouter.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-mr-YOUR_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
    "stream": true,
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Write a haiku about APIs"}]
  }'
```

### List Models
```
GET /v1/models
```
Returns all available models with their IDs, provider, and pricing.

```bash
curl https://marketrouter.ai/v1/models \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-mr-YOUR_KEY"
```

### Embeddings
```
POST /v1/embeddings
```
Compatible with OpenAI embeddings API. Supports text-embedding-3-small, text-embedding-3-large, text-embedding-ada-002.

### Image Generation
```
POST /v1/images/generations
```
Supports DALL-E 3, Stable Diffusion, Flux, and Midjourney-compatible models.

### Audio / Speech
```
POST /v1/audio/transcriptions
POST /v1/audio/speech
```
Whisper-compatible transcription and TTS endpoints.

## SDK Integration Examples

### Python (openai library)
```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="https://marketrouter.ai/v1",
    api_key="sk-mr-YOUR_KEY"
)

# Basic completion
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Explain quantum computing in 2 sentences"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)

# Streaming
stream = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Write a Python web scraper"}],
    stream=True
)
for chunk in stream:
    print(chunk.choices[0].delta.content or "", end="")

# Function calling
tools = [{
    "type": "function",
    "function": {
        "name": "get_weather",
        "description": "Get weather for a city",
        "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}},
            "required": ["city"]
        }
    }
}]
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What's the weather in Shanghai?"}],
    tools=tools,
    tool_choice="auto"
)
```

### Node.js / TypeScript
```typescript
import OpenAI from 'openai';

const client = new OpenAI({
  baseURL: 'https://marketrouter.ai/v1',
  apiKey: 'sk-mr-YOUR_KEY',
});

const response = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: 'gpt-4o',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }],
});
console.log(response.choices[0].message.content);
```

### LangChain (Python)
```python
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI

llm = ChatOpenAI(
    model="gpt-4o",
    openai_api_base="https://marketrouter.ai/v1",
    openai_api_key="sk-mr-YOUR_KEY"
)
result = llm.invoke("Summarize the history of AI")
print(result.content)
```

### LangChain (JS)
```javascript
import { ChatOpenAI } from "@langchain/openai";

const llm = new ChatOpenAI({
  modelName: "gpt-4o",
  configuration: {
    baseURL: "https://marketrouter.ai/v1",
    apiKey: "sk-mr-YOUR_KEY",
  },
});
```

## AI Tool Configuration

### Cursor
```
Settings → Models → Add Model
OpenAI API Key: sk-mr-YOUR_KEY
OpenAI Base URL: https://marketrouter.ai/v1
```

### Cline (VS Code)
```
API Provider: OpenAI Compatible
Base URL: https://marketrouter.ai/v1
API Key: sk-mr-YOUR_KEY
Model: gpt-4o (or any supported model)
```

### Claude Code (CLI)
```bash
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-mr-YOUR_KEY
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://marketrouter.ai/v1
# or via claude config
claude config set api_key sk-mr-YOUR_KEY
claude config set api_url https://marketrouter.ai/v1
```

### Continue (VS Code)
```json
{
  "models": [{
    "provider": "openai",
    "model": "gpt-4o",
    "apiBase": "https://marketrouter.ai/v1",
    "apiKey": "sk-mr-YOUR_KEY"
  }]
}
```

### n8n
```
Credential Type: OpenAI API
API Key: sk-mr-YOUR_KEY
Base URL: https://marketrouter.ai/v1
```

### OpenWebUI / LibreChat / LobeChat
```
OpenAI Base URL: https://marketrouter.ai/v1
API Key: sk-mr-YOUR_KEY
```

## Pricing & Credits

- **Credits**: 1 credit = $0.01 USD
- **Top-up methods**: Stripe (card), Alipay, WeChat Pay, USDT/crypto
- **First top-up bonus**: Top up $10+, get extra $10 credits free
- **Monthly plans**: Save 15–20% vs pay-as-you-go
- **Model pricing**: Varies by provider; DeepSeek-V3 is typically 90%+ cheaper than GPT-4o for comparable tasks

---

## Why Use Market Router Instead of Direct APIs?

| Feature | Market Router | Direct APIs |
|---|---|---|
| Single key for all models | ✅ | ❌ (one key per provider) |
| CN region access (no VPN) | ✅ | ❌ |
| Automatic failover | ✅ | ❌ |
| Cost optimization routing | ✅ | ❌ |
| Alipay / WeChat payment | ✅ | ❌ |
| Usage analytics dashboard | ✅ | Limited |
| First-time top-up bonus | ✅ | ❌ |

---

## FAQ

**Q: Is it really OpenAI-compatible?**
A: Yes. Any app using the official OpenAI SDK works with zero code changes — just swap the base URL and key.

**Q: Does it support vision / multimodal?**
A: Yes. GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, and Gemini 2.0 Flash all support image inputs via the standard OpenAI vision format.

**Q: What about rate limits?**
A: Limits depend on your credit balance and subscription plan. Higher tiers get higher RPM.

**Q: Can I use it for AI agents / autonomous tasks?**
A: Yes — this is a primary use case. Works with AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph, and any agentic framework.

**Q: Is there a free trial?**
A: New users get 3 free guest chat messages on the homepage. Create an account for full API access.
